article.part: Referencia y predicación adjetival — Референция и адъективная предикация

claims.summary: Timberlake characterizes -нибудь pronoun compounds as existential forms for an indeterminate entity and describes their use in contexts of epistemological uncertainty; this entry is narrowed to that distinction.

locator.label: § 4.8.3, pp. 260–261, lines 9777–9796; compounds in -нибудь are existential and used when an entity or its properties are indeterminate, including epistemological uncertainty.
